crossRefs.note: As you enter into the household, greet it.
If you love those who love you, what credit is that to you? For even sinners love those who love them.
Carry no purse, nor wallet, nor sandals. Greet no one on the way.
Into whatever house you enter, first say, ‘Peace be to this house.’
For I tell you that unless your righteousness exceeds that of the scribes and Pharisees, there is no way you will enter…
For what glory is it if, when you sin, you patiently endure beating? But if, when you do well, you patiently endure…

translations.web: If you only greet your friends, what more do you do than others? Don’t even the tax collectors do the same?
translations.bsb: And if you greet only your brothers, what are you doing more than others? Do not even Gentiles do the same?
translations.kjv: And if ye salute your brethren only, what do ye more than others? do not even the publicans so?
translations.asv: And if ye salute your brethren only, what do ye more than others? do not even the Gentiles the same?
